The Neighborhood Teacher

Helping someone discover what they can do.

Seeing the possibility

In this sample story, a teacher recognizes a spark in someone who has not seen it in themselves. They make a difficult idea approachable and create a space where questions are welcome.

Showing up, again and again

The teacher prepares, listens, and adjusts. They know that good teaching is a craft. They take it seriously, and keep learning how to do it better.

Why a good gardener?

This example honors the care that helps another person grow. The teacher brings something to life through dedication to their own work and belief in what others can become.
